skills.name: canva-brand-check
skills.description: Check a Canva design against a brand kit and report where it diverges — off-palette colors, non-brand fonts, logo misuse, and off-tone copy. Read-only; makes no changes. Use when the user asks "is this on brand", "check this against our brand kit", "do a brand review", "does this match our brand guidelines", or "brand-check my design".
headings: The brand-kit data gap — read this first
Reading the design's actual colors and fonts
Brand check — "<design title>" vs "<brand kit name>"
skills.description_zh: 只读检查 Canva 设计是否符合品牌套件，报告偏离色板、字体、标志和文案语气之处，不修改设计。

skills.name: canva-bulk-create
skills.description: Bulk-create Canva designs from tabular data using a brand template with autofill fields, producing one design per row. Use when users say "bulk create designs from this CSV", "generate one design per row", "create a design for each product", "batch generate from a template", or "autofill a template from a spreadsheet". Accepts any tabular data source — uploaded files, pasted tables, JSON, or URLs.
headings: Step 4: Map CSV Columns to Template Fields
Step 5: Bulk Create — One Design per Row
skills.description_zh: 使用带自动填充字段的 Canva 品牌模板，从上传表格、粘贴数据、JSON 或 URL 批量生成设计，每行对应一份。

skills.name: canva-edit-design
skills.description: Make edits to an existing Canva design — change or fix text, replace/insert/delete images and videos, reformat text (size, weight, style, color, alignment, lists, line height), reposition or resize elements, and update the title. Use when the user wants to change, edit, update, fix, translate, replace, or reformat content in a specific Canva design. This is the safe edit engine that other Canva skills (e.g. implement-feedback) build on.
headings: The Transaction Protocol (always these steps, in order)
Capabilities — what the API CAN and CANNOT do
Step 2: Start the transaction and inspect
skills.description_zh: 编辑既有 Canva 设计，修改文字、插删替换图片/视频、文字样式与行高、元素位置/尺寸和标题，作为其他反馈实施 skill 的编辑基础。

skills.name: canva-design-feedback
skills.description: Read a Canva design and return structured, actionable design feedback — visual hierarchy, copy/messaging, layout & spacing, consistency, readability, and accessibility. Read-only; makes no changes to the design. Use when the user asks to "review my design", "give me feedback on this", "critique my deck/poster/flyer", "how can I improve this design", or "what's wrong with this slide".
headings: What you can actually read (and the gap to know about)
skills.description_zh: 只读审阅 Canva 设计的视觉层级、文案、布局间距、一致性、可读性和无障碍，返回结构化可执行反馈，不改设计。

skills.name: canva-implement-feedback
skills.description: Implement reviewer feedback on a Canva design. Reads all comment threads, synthesises what reviewers want, makes the clear-cut changes directly, and flags anything that needs a human decision. Use when the user asks to "implement feedback on my deck", "address comments on a design", "apply review feedback", "fix the comments on my presentation", or "implement the feedback".
headings: Canva Editing API — What You Can and Cannot Do
Step 4: Get User Approval — ONE time only
Step 5: Apply and Commit the Changes
Changes to make manually in Canva
skills.description_zh: 读取 Canva 设计全部评论线程，归纳评审要求，直接实施明确变更，并标出需要人工决定的事项，适用于演示或设计反馈落实。

skills.name: canva-resize-for-social-media
skills.description: Resize a Canva design into multiple social media formats (Facebook post, Facebook story, Instagram post, Instagram story, LinkedIn post). Use this skill when users want to resize Canva designs specifically for multiple social media platforms in one operation, rather than resizing to a single format manually.
headings: Step 3: Ask Which Platforms and Formats
Step 5: Present Results with Edit Links
skills.description_zh: 一次将 Canva 设计适配为 Facebook 帖子/故事、Instagram 帖子/故事和 LinkedIn 帖子等多平台格式。

skills.name: canva-branded-presentation
skills.description: Create on-brand Canva presentations from an outline or brief. Use when the user asks to create a branded presentation, make an on-brand deck, turn an outline into slides, or generate a presentation from a brief. Input can be text directly in the message, a Canva design ID, a reference to a Canva doc by name, or a Canva design link (e.g., https://www.canva.com/design/...).

skills.name: canva-classroom-helper
skills.description: Turn a lesson plan into a teaching slide deck in Canva. Use when the user asks to build classroom slides from a lesson plan, convert a lesson plan into a presentation, make a teaching deck, create school slides from an outline, or generate a lesson deck for students. Input can be a lesson plan pasted in the message, a Canva design ID, a Canva doc or design by name, or a Canva design link (e.g., https://www.canva.com/design/...).
headings: Canva Classroom Helper — Lesson Plan to Deck
Visuals — where they come from and how to avoid bad images

skills.name: canva-translate-design
skills.description: Translate all text in a Canva design to another language, creating a translated copy. Faster than manually copying and editing each text box in Canva's editor. Use when users say "translate my design to [language]", "make a Spanish/French/etc version", or "localize my Canva design".

skills.name: canva-presentation-time-fitting
skills.description: Fit a Canva presentation to a target speaking duration by generating or rewriting presenter notes only (visible slide text is not edited). Use when users say "make this a 10-minute presentation", "split time evenly across slides", "generate speaker notes for a 15-minute talk", "fit my deck to [duration]", or "how long per slide for a 20-minute slot".
headings: Step 1: Collect design and duration (before other Canva tool calls)
Step 6: Generate speaker notes (in this session)
Step 7: Write notes back to Canva
